problem: Netlify production uses STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE=1, but pre-merge gates did not execute the exact static locale cache completeness validator. A linked production build could therefore fail only after merge.
root_cause: The production build contract and the pre-merge test contract diverged: build-localized-routes.mjs can fail closed on any uncached public string, while Required/BRAIN could still be green without running --validate-cache against the complete current public route set.
prevention: Run tools/site-shell/build-localized-routes.mjs --validate-cache in regression coverage before merge.
Any new or changed public copy must carry its English cache entry in the same lineage.
Do not weaken STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE=1 to make production green; repair the cache authority instead.
Only after cache validation passes may Netlify production promotion proceed to exact-SHA and pricing/i18n browser proof.
